title: NOVEL LACTIC ACID BACTERIUM HAVING SUPERTEXTURIZING PROPERTY WITH MUTATIONS IN THE GalK GENE AND METHODS FOR MANUFACTURING SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a lactic acid bacterium which allows to generate a high viscosity in fermented milk, to a lactic acid bacterium for generating a high viscosity in fermented milk, to compositions usable as a starter culture, to a method for producing a fermented dairy product.
